name: snipershady/amilon
description: PHP client library for the Amilon API: order, manage and distribute digital gift cards at scale

post-install-cmd:
echo "
✅ Dependencies installed. Run 'composer quality' to apply code quality fixes.
"
post-update-cmd:
echo "
✅ Dependencies updated. Run 'composer quality' to apply code quality fixes.
"

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the whole PHPUnit suite (integration tests skip without live Amilon credentials)
scripts-descriptions.rector-dry: Run Rector in dry-run mode (preview changes without applying)
scripts-descriptions.cs-fix: Fix code style issues with PHP-CS-Fixer
scripts-descriptions.cs-check: Check code style without making changes
scripts-descriptions.quality-check: Check code quality without making changes (dry-run mode)
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the unit suite only: no I/O, runnable anywhere
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the integration suite against the Amilon sandbox (needs AMILON_* env vars)
